title: Explicit formula for a canonical restricted cohomology map
statement: Let S, Y and Y' be schemes, a : Y' → Y, h : Y → S, h' : Y' → S and w : a ≫ h = h'. Let F and F' be abelian etale sheaves on Y and Y', and let phi : a*F → F'. For a natural degree p and an etale U → S, the map rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap [def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology] is heterogeneously equal to the following explicit composite: rawAffineComplexPullback along rawAffineRestrictedMap, applied to the degree-zero single complex of F restricted to U ×_S Y, followed by cohomology of Q of the single-complex inverse-image comparison followed by singleFunctor.map of rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient. The full formula and all universes are recorded verbatim in lean.statement. No affine, quasi-compact, directed-system, or limit hypotheses are needed.

source.place: Canonical cohomology pullback followed by the map induced by a coefficient morphism; the explicit restriction construction is def-sbc-raw-affine-restricted-cohomology.

proof.text: Expand the definition of rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap. Its local q is rawAffineRestrictedMap a h h' w U and its local R is the restriction of F along the second projection. Its value is rawAffineComplexPullback on the single complex of R, followed by cohomology of Q of the single comparison and single map of the restricted coefficient morphism. Substituting q and R gives exactly the displayed expression, so HEq reflexivity proves the formula. The use of HEq allows the raw cohomology object wrappers to remain folded in applications. The argument works unchanged for zero coefficients, degree zero, and identity scheme maps, since it is the defining composite, with no cancellation or nonzero assumptions.

lean.statement:
theorem rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap_formula {S Y Y' : Scheme.{v}} (a : Y' ⟶ Y)
    (h : Y ⟶ S) (h' : Y' ⟶ S) (w : a ≫ h = h') (p : ℕ)
    (F : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (F' : Sheaf Y'.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1})
    (φ : (upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} a).obj F ⟶ F') (U : S.Etale) :
    HEq (rawAffineRestrictedCohomologyMap a h h' w p F F' φ U)
      (rawAffineComplexPullback (p : ℤ) (rawAffineRestrictedMap a h h' w U)
          ((CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).obj
            ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback.snd U.hom h)).obj F)) ≫
        (cohomology AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback U.hom h') (p : ℤ)).map
          (DerivedCategory.Q.map
            (((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1}
                (rawAffineRestrictedMap a h h' w U)).mapCochainComplexSingleFunctor 0).hom.app
                ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{v + 1} (pullback.snd U.hom h)).obj F) ≫
              (CochainComplex.singleFunctor _ 0).map
                (rawAffineRestrictedCoefficient a h h' w F F' φ U))))
